--!strict
-- ShopService
-- Orquestador transaccional central del Shop Framework.
-- Responsabilidades:
-- - Registro y resolución desacoplada de ProductProviders vía ShopRegistry.
-- - Validación autoritativa de productos, disponibilidad y bloqueos transaccionales.
-- - Enrutamiento de divisas (Coins vs Robux) sin acoplamiento a categorías de productos.
-- - Preparación de la API de compra (PurchaseProduct), equipamiento (EquipProduct) y desequipamiento (UnequipProduct).
-- Nota: En Fase 2 la infraestructura central queda completamente tipada y validada; la deducción/persistencia de inventario
-- se implementa en la Fase 4 y la integración de MarketplaceService en la Fase 6.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Types = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Types)

type ProductDefinition = Types.ProductDefinition
type ProductProvider = Types.ProductProvider

local ShopService = {}
ShopService.Name = "ShopService"

ShopService._context = nil :: any
ShopService._registry = nil :: any
ShopService._playerService = nil :: any
ShopService._inProgressPurchases = {} :: { [any]: boolean }

-- Utilidad para garantizar carpetas en la jerarquía
local function ensureFolder(parent: Instance, name: string): Folder
	local existing = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing:IsA("Folder") then
		return existing
	end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = name
	folder.Parent = parent
	return folder
end

-- ==================================================
-- INICIALIZACIÓN DEL SERVICIO
-- ==================================================

function ShopService:Init(context: any)
	self._context = context
	self._inProgressPurchases = {}

	-- Asegurar la existencia del namespace de remotes para la tienda
	local remotesFolder = ensureFolder(ReplicatedStorage, "Remotes")
	ensureFolder(remotesFolder, "Shop")

	-- Resolver ShopRegistry
	self:_getRegistryInternal()

	-- Auto-registrar PointEffectProvider
	self:_registerDefaultProviders()

	-- Exponer la Remote API del Shop al cliente (delegada en ShopRemotes)
	local shopFolder = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild("Shop")
	local remotesMod = shopFolder and shopFolder:FindFirstChild("ShopRemotes")
	if remotesMod and remotesMod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			require(remotesMod):Init(self)
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn(string.format("[ShopService] No se pudo inicializar ShopRemotes: %s", tostring(err)))
		end
	else
		warn("[ShopService] ShopRemotes no encontrado; la tienda no estará disponible para el cliente")
	end
end

function ShopService:_registerDefaultProviders()
	local shopFolder = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild("Shop")
	local providersFolder = shopFolder and shopFolder:FindFirstChild("Providers")
	if providersFolder then
		local pepMod = providersFolder:FindFirstChild("PointEffectProvider")
		if pepMod and pepMod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local ok, pep = pcall(require, pepMod)
			if ok and pep and not self:GetProvider(pep:GetCategory()) then
				self:RegisterProvider(pep)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Fallback relativo si la estructura aún no cargó completamente
	if not self:GetProvider("PointEffects") then
		local ok, pep = pcall(function()
			return require(script.Parent.Parent.Shop.Providers.PointEffectProvider)
		end)
		if ok and pep and not self:GetProvider("PointEffects") then
			self:RegisterProvider(pep)
		end
	end
	if not self:GetProvider("DeathEffects") then
		local provider = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shop.Providers.DeathEffectProvider)
		self:RegisterProvider(provider)
	end
end

function ShopService:Start(context: any)
	self._context = context
	self:_registerDefaultProviders()
	print("[ShopService] Orquestador transaccional de tienda iniciado y listo")
end

-- ==================================================
-- RESOLUCIÓN DE DEPENDENCIAS
-- ==================================================

function ShopService:_getRegistryInternal(): any
	if self._registry then
		return self._registry
	end

	-- 1. Intentar resolver mediante ServerScriptService.Shop.ShopRegistry
	local shopFolder = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild("Shop")
	if shopFolder then
		local regMod = shopFolder:FindFirstChild("ShopRegistry")
		if regMod and regMod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local ok, mod = pcall(require, regMod)
			if ok and mod then
				self._registry = mod
				return mod
			end
		end
	end

	-- 2. Fallback de resolución relativa directa para tests / bootstrap
	local ok, mod = pcall(function()
		return require(script.Parent.Parent.Shop.ShopRegistry)
	end)
	if ok and mod then
		self._registry = mod
		return mod
	end

	warn("[ShopService] No se pudo resolver ShopRegistry automáticamente")
	return nil
end

function ShopService:GetRegistry(): any
	return self:_getRegistryInternal()
end

function ShopService:SetRegistry(registry: any)
	self._registry = registry
end

function ShopService:_getPlayerService(): any
	if self._playerService then
		return self._playerService
	end
	if self._context and type(self._context.GetService) == "function" then
		local s = self._context:GetService("PlayerService")
		if s then
			self._playerService = s
			return s
		end
	end
	local servicesFolder = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild("Services")
	local mod = servicesFolder and servicesFolder:FindFirstChild("PlayerService")
	if mod and mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, result = pcall(require, mod)
		if ok and result then
			self._playerService = result
			return result
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- ==================================================
-- API DEL REGISTRO (DELEGACIÓN)
-- ==================================================

-- Registra un ProductProvider delegando en ShopRegistry
function ShopService:RegisterProvider(provider: ProductProvider)
	local registry = self:GetRegistry()
	assert(registry, "[ShopService] Registry no disponible para registrar provider")
	registry:Register(provider)
end

-- Obtiene el ProductProvider correspondiente a una categoría
function ShopService:GetProvider(category: string): ProductProvider?
	local registry = self:GetRegistry()
	if not registry then return nil end
	return registry:GetProvider(category)
end

-- Obtiene el catálogo unificado de productos (o filtrado por categoría si se especifica)
function ShopService:GetCatalog(category: string?): { ProductDefinition }
	local registry = self:GetRegistry()
	if not registry then return {} end
	if category and category ~= "" then
		return registry:GetCategoryProducts(category)
	end
	return registry:GetCatalog()
end

-- Obtiene un producto por su Id
function ShopService:GetProduct(productId: string): ProductDefinition?
	local registry = self:GetRegistry()
	if not registry then return nil end
	return registry:GetProduct(productId)
end

-- Obtiene un producto por su RobloxProductId
function ShopService:GetProductByRobloxId(robloxId: number): ProductDefinition?
	local registry = self:GetRegistry()
	if not registry then return nil end
	return registry:GetProductByRobloxId(robloxId)
end

-- ==================================================
-- GESTIÓN DE BLOQUEOS TRANSACCIONALES (IN-FLIGHT LOCKS)
-- ==================================================

function ShopService:IsTransactionInProgress(player: any): boolean
	return self._inProgressPurchases[player] == true
end

function ShopService:_setTransactionLock(player: any, locked: boolean)
	if locked then
		self._inProgressPurchases[player] = true
	else
		self._inProgressPurchases[player] = nil
	end
end

-- ==================================================
-- ORQUESTACIÓN DE COMPRAS (PURCHASE API)
-- ==================================================

-- Solicita la compra autoritativa de un producto.
-- Valida existencia, disponibilidad, locks transaccionales y enruta según Currency.
function ShopService:PurchaseProduct(player: any, productId: string): (boolean, string?)
	if not player then
		return false, "InvalidPlayer"
	end
	if type(productId) ~= "string" or productId == "" then
		return false, "InvalidProductId"
	end
	local ps = self:_getPlayerService()
	if not ps or not ps:IsShopDataReady(player) then return false, "DataNotLoaded" end

	-- Verificar si el jugador ya tiene una transacción activa
	if self:IsTransactionInProgress(player) then
		return false, "TransactionInProgress"
	end

	local registry = self:GetRegistry()
	if not registry then
		return false, "RegistryNotAvailable"
	end

	local product = registry:GetProduct(productId)
	if not product then
		return false, "ProductNotFound"
	end

	if not product.IsAvailable then
		return false, "ProductUnavailable"
	end

	local provider = registry:GetProvider(product.Category)
	if not provider then
		return false, "ProviderNotFound"
	end

	-- Validación de dominio por el ProductProvider (ej: ya poseído, nivel insuficiente, etc.)
	local canPurchase, canPurchaseErr = provider:CanPurchase(player, product)
	if not canPurchase then
		return false, canPurchaseErr or "CannotPurchase"
	end

	-- Enrutamiento autoritativo según la divisa del producto
	if product.Currency == "Coins" then
		return self:_processCoinsPurchase(player, product, provider)
	elseif product.Currency == "Robux" then
		return self:_processRobuxPurchase(player, product, provider)
	else
		return false, "UnsupportedCurrency"
	end
end

-- Procesa compras con moneda interna (Coins)
function ShopService:_processCoinsPurchase(player: any, product: ProductDefinition, provider: ProductProvider): (boolean, string?)
	local playerService = self:_getPlayerService()
	if not playerService then
		return false, "PlayerServiceNotAvailable"
	end

	-- 1. Verificación autoritativa de fondos vía API pública de PlayerService (sin acceder a tablas privadas)
	local currentCoins = playerService:GetCoins(player)
	if currentCoins < product.Price then
		return false, "InsufficientFunds"
	end

	-- 2. Lock transaccional in-flight
	self:_setTransactionLock(player, true)

	-- 3. Deducción atómica de fondos
	local deductOk, newBalance = playerService:DeductCoins(player, product.Price, "ShopPurchase:" .. product.Id)
	if not deductOk then
		self:_setTransactionLock(player, false)
		return false, "DeductFundsFailed"
	end

	-- 4. Entrega autoritativa mediante ProductProvider
	local deliveryOk, deliveryErr = provider:OnPurchased(player, product)
	if not deliveryOk then
		-- Rollback atómico de fondos si la entrega falla
		playerService:AddCoins(player, product.Price, "ShopPurchaseRefund:" .. product.Id)
		self:_setTransactionLock(player, false)
		warn(string.format("[ShopService] Entrega de '%s' falló para '%s' (err: %s). Fondos reembolsados.",
			product.Id, tostring(player), tostring(deliveryErr)))
		return false, deliveryErr or "DeliveryFailed"
	end

	self:_setTransactionLock(player, false)
	print(string.format("[ShopService] Compra exitosa de '%s' por '%s'. Saldo restante: %d",
		product.Id, tostring(player), newBalance))
	return true, nil
end

-- Procesa compras con moneda de plataforma (Robux)
function ShopService:_processRobuxPurchase(player: any, product: ProductDefinition, provider: ProductProvider): (boolean, string?)
	if not product.RobloxProductId or product.RobloxProductId <= 0 then
		return false, "MissingRobloxProductId"
	end

	-- En Fase 2 (Core Framework): la definición y validación de Robux/RobloxProductId están establecidas.
	-- La integración con el prompt y ProcessReceipt de MarketplaceService se conecta en Fase 6.
	return false, "MarketplaceIntegrationPendingPhase6"
end

-- ==================================================
-- ORQUESTACIÓN DE EQUIPAMIENTO (EQUIP / UNEQUIP API)
-- ==================================================

-- Solicita equipar un cosmético
function ShopService:EquipProduct(player: any, productId: string): (boolean, string?)
	if not player then
		return false, "InvalidPlayer"
	end
	if type(productId) ~= "string" or productId == "" then
		return false, "InvalidProductId"
	end
	local ps = self:_getPlayerService()
	if not ps or not ps:IsShopDataReady(player) then return false, "DataNotLoaded" end

	local registry = self:GetRegistry()
	if not registry then
		return false, "RegistryNotAvailable"
	end

	local product = registry:GetProduct(productId)
	if not product then
		return false, "ProductNotFound"
	end

	if product.ProductType ~= "Cosmetic" then
		return false, "NotEquippable"
	end
	if not product.IsAvailable then return false, "ProductUnavailable" end

	local provider = registry:GetProvider(product.Category)
	if not provider then
		return false, "ProviderNotFound"
	end

	local canEquip, canEquipErr = provider:CanEquip(player, product)
	if not canEquip then
		return false, canEquipErr or "CannotEquip"
	end

	local equipOk, equipErr = provider:OnEquipped(player, product)
	if not equipOk then
		return false, equipErr or "EquipFailed"
	end

	return true, nil
end

-- Solicita desequipar el cosmético activo de una categoría
function ShopService:UnequipProduct(player: any, category: string): (boolean, string?)
	if not player then
		return false, "InvalidPlayer"
	end
	if type(category) ~= "string" or category == "" then
		return false, "InvalidCategory"
	end
	local ps = self:_getPlayerService()
	if not ps or not ps:IsShopDataReady(player) then return false, "DataNotLoaded" end

	local registry = self:GetRegistry()
	if not registry then
		return false, "RegistryNotAvailable"
	end

	local provider = registry:GetProvider(category)
	if not provider then
		return false, "ProviderNotFound"
	end

	local unequipOk, unequipErr = provider:OnUnequipped(player, nil)
	if not unequipOk then
		return false, unequipErr or "UnequipFailed"
	end

	return true, nil
end

return ShopService

--!strict
-- PlayerService
-- Ciclo de vida de jugadores: registro/desregistro, estado económico y datos runtime (Coins, Wins, Losses).
-- Servidor autoritativo. Integrado con PlayerDataService para persistencia segura vía DataStoreService.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PointEffectDefinitions = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.PointEffectDefinitions)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Types = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Types)
local Constants = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Constants)
local DeathSettings = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.DeathFeedbackConfig).DeathEffects

type PlayerData = Types.PlayerData

local PlayerService = {}
PlayerService.Name = "PlayerService"

PlayerService._context = nil :: any
PlayerService._registered = {}
PlayerService._connections = {} :: { RBXScriptConnection }
PlayerService._data = {} :: { [any]: PlayerData }
PlayerService._coins = {} :: { [any]: number } -- Retrocompatibilidad
PlayerService._kills = {} :: { [any]: number }
PlayerService._coinTransactions = {} :: { [any]: { [string]: boolean } }
PlayerService._ownedPointEffects = {} :: { [any]: { [string]: boolean } }
PlayerService._equippedPointEffects = {} :: { [any]: string }
PlayerService._dataUpdatedRemote = nil :: RemoteEvent?
PlayerService._playerDataService = nil :: any

-- Utilidad para garantizar la existencia de RemoteEvents
local function ensureRemote(parent: Instance, name: string): RemoteEvent
	local existing = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		return existing
	end
	local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = name
	remote.Parent = parent
	return remote
end

local function ensureFolder(parent: Instance, name: string): Folder
	local existing = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing:IsA("Folder") then
		return existing
	end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = name
	folder.Parent = parent
	return folder
end

function PlayerService:Init(context)
	self._context = context
	self._registered = {}
	self._connections = {}
	self._data = {}
	self._coins = {}
	self._kills = {}
	self._coinTransactions = {}
	self._ownedPointEffects = {}
	self._equippedPointEffects = {}

	self:_getDataUpdatedRemote()
end

function PlayerService:_getDataUpdatedRemote(): RemoteEvent?
	if self._dataUpdatedRemote and self._dataUpdatedRemote.Parent then
		return self._dataUpdatedRemote
	end
	local remotesFolder = ensureFolder(ReplicatedStorage, "Remotes")
	local playerFolder = ensureFolder(remotesFolder, "Player")
	local remote = ensureRemote(playerFolder, "DataUpdated")
	self._dataUpdatedRemote = remote
	return remote
end

-- Sincroniza las estadísticas del jugador con el folder nativo leaderstats de Roblox
function PlayerService:_syncLeaderstats(player: any, data: PlayerData)
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then
		return
	end

	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "leaderstats"

		local coinsVal = Instance.new("IntValue")
		coinsVal.Name = "Coins"
		coinsVal.Value = data.Coins
		coinsVal.Parent = folder

		local winsVal = Instance.new("IntValue")
		winsVal.Name = "Wins"
		winsVal.Value = data.Wins
		winsVal.Parent = folder

		local killsVal = Instance.new("IntValue")
		killsVal.Name = "Kills"
		killsVal.Value = data.Kills or 0
		killsVal.Parent = folder

		folder.Parent = player
	else
		local coinsVal = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins") :: IntValue?
		if not coinsVal then
			coinsVal = Instance.new("IntValue")
			coinsVal.Name = "Coins"
			coinsVal.Value = data.Coins
			coinsVal.Parent = leaderstats
		else
			coinsVal.Value = data.Coins
		end

		local winsVal = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Wins") :: IntValue?
		if not winsVal then
			winsVal = Instance.new("IntValue")
			winsVal.Name = "Wins"
			winsVal.Value = data.Wins
			winsVal.Parent = leaderstats
		else
			winsVal.Value = data.Wins
		end

		local killsVal = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Kills") :: IntValue?
		if not killsVal then
			killsVal = Instance.new("IntValue")
			killsVal.Name = "Kills"
			killsVal.Value = data.Kills or 0
			killsVal.Parent = leaderstats
		else
			killsVal.Value = data.Kills or 0
		end
	end
end

-- Envía actualización autoritativa de datos al cliente correspondiente y sincroniza leaderstats
function PlayerService:_sendDataUpdate(player: any)
	if typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player") then
		local data = self:GetPlayerData(player)
		self:_syncLeaderstats(player, data)

		local remote = self:_getDataUpdatedRemote()
		if remote then
			remote:FireClient(player, data)
		end
	end
end

function PlayerService:_getPlayerDataService(): any
	if self._playerDataService then
		return self._playerDataService
	end
	if self._context and type(self._context.GetService) == "function" then
		local s = self._context:GetService("PlayerDataService")
		if s then
			self._playerDataService = s
			return s
		end
	end
	local ok, mod = pcall(require, script.Parent.PlayerDataService)
	if ok and mod then
		self._playerDataService = mod
		return mod
	end
	return nil
end

function PlayerService:_register(player: any)
	self._registered[player] = {}

	local initialData: PlayerData = {
		Coins = (Config.Economy and Config.Economy.StartingCoins) or 0,
		Wins = (Config.Economy and Config.Economy.StartingWins) or 0,
		Losses = (Config.Economy and Config.Economy.StartingLosses) or 0,
		Kills = (Config.Economy and Config.Economy.StartingKills) or 0,
		Inventory = {
			Owned = {
				["PointEffects"] = { [PointEffectDefinitions.DefaultEffectId] = true },
				["DeathEffects"] = { [DeathSettings.DefaultKillEffectId] = true },
			},
			Equipped = {
				["PointEffects"] = PointEffectDefinitions.DefaultEffectId,
				["DeathEffects"] = DeathSettings.DefaultKillEffectId,
			},
		},
	}

	if typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player") then
		local pds = self:_getPlayerDataService()
		if pds and type(pds.LoadPlayer) == "function" then
			local ok, record, err = pds:LoadPlayer(player)
			if ok and record then
				initialData.Coins = record.Coins
				initialData.Wins = record.Wins
				initialData.Losses = record.Losses
				initialData.Kills = record.Kills or 0
				if record.Inventory then
					initialData.Inventory = record.Inventory
				end
			else
				warn(string.format("[PlayerService] No se pudo cargar PlayerData de '%s' (err: %s). Usando valores seguros no persistibles.", player.Name, tostring(err)))
			end
		end
	end

	self._data[player] = initialData
	self._coins[player] = initialData.Coins
	self._kills[player] = initialData.Kills
	self._ownedPointEffects[player] = initialData.Inventory.Owned["PointEffects"]
	self._equippedPointEffects[player] = initialData.Inventory.Equipped["PointEffects"] or PointEffectDefinitions.DefaultEffectId

	local pName = if type(player) == "table" and player.Name then player.Name elseif typeof(player) == "Instance" then player.Name else tostring(player)
	print(string.format("[PlayerService] Registrado: %s (Coins=%d, Wins=%d, Losses=%d, Kills=%d, PointEffect: %s)",
		pName, initialData.Coins, initialData.Wins, initialData.Losses, initialData.Kills, tostring(self._equippedPointEffects[player])))

	-- Enviar estado inicial cargado al jugador (el HUD muestra inmediatamente datos reales sin parpadeo de 0)
	self:_sendDataUpdate(player)
end

function PlayerService:_unregister(player: any)
	if typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player") then
		local pds = self:_getPlayerDataService()
		if pds and type(pds.SavePlayer) == "function" then
			local currentData = self._data[player]
			pds:SavePlayer(player, currentData)
			if type(pds.Cleanup) == "function" then
				pds:Cleanup(player)
			end
		end
	end

	self._registered[player] = nil
	self._data[player] = nil
	self._coins[player] = nil
	self._kills[player] = nil
	self._coinTransactions[player] = nil
	self._ownedPointEffects[player] = nil
	self._equippedPointEffects[player] = nil

	local pName = if type(player) == "table" and player.Name then player.Name elseif typeof(player) == "Instance" then player.Name else tostring(player)
	print(string.format("[PlayerService] Desregistrado: %s", pName))
end

-- ==================================================
-- INTERFAZ AUTORITATIVA DE ECONOMÍA Y ESTADÍSTICAS
-- ==================================================

function PlayerService:AddCoins(player: any, amount: number, reason: string, transactionId: string?): (number, number)
	if not player or amount ~= amount or amount <= 0 or amount == math.huge then
		return self:GetCoins(player), 0
	end

	local data = self._data[player]
	if transactionId then
		-- Transactional awards never reload/recreate a disconnected or missing profile.
		if transactionId == "" or not data then return self:GetCoins(player), 0 end
		local transactions = self._coinTransactions[player]
		if not transactions then transactions = {}; self._coinTransactions[player] = transactions end
		if transactions[transactionId] then return self:GetCoins(player), 0 end
		-- No yields between reserving the key and committing the in-memory balance.
		transactions[transactionId] = true
	end
	if not data then
		self:_register(player)
		data = self._data[player]
	end

	local newBalance = data.Coins + amount
	data.Coins = newBalance
	self._coins[player] = newBalance

	local pName = if type(player) == "table" and player.Name then player.Name elseif typeof(player) == "Instance" then player.Name else tostring(player)
	print(string.format("[PlayerService] +%d Coins otorgados a '%s' (Razón: %s). Saldo: %d",
		amount, pName, reason or "Unspecified", newBalance))

	if transactionId then
		-- Failure to notify cannot roll back a committed award or allow a second credit.
		local ok, failure = pcall(self._sendDataUpdate, self, player)
		if not ok then warn("[PlayerService] Committed Coins; data notification failed: " .. tostring(failure)) end
	else
		self:_sendDataUpdate(player)
	end
	return newBalance, amount
end

-- Called only by the elimination authority after its final credited-kill decision.
-- Separate from AddKill so generic stat corrections never create money.
function PlayerService:AwardConfirmedKill(player: Player, victim: Player, sessionId: string, eliminationId: string): (number, number)
	if not player or not victim or player == victim or player.Parent ~= Players or victim.Parent ~= Players then
		return 0, self:GetCoins(player)
	end
	local rounds = self._context and self._context:GetService("RoundService")
	local session = rounds and rounds:GetSessionById(sessionId)
	if not session or not rounds:IsSessionActive(sessionId) or session.GameplayFrozen
		or session.Closing or session.Cancelled or session.Closed
		or (session.State ~= Constants.RoundState.Playing and session.State ~= Constants.RoundState.PointRestartCountdown) then
		return 0, self:GetCoins(player)
	end
	local attacker = rounds:GetSessionParticipant(sessionId, player)
	local target = rounds:GetSessionParticipant(sessionId, victim)
	local prefix = sessionId .. "_" .. tostring(victim.UserId) .. "_"
	if not attacker or not target or attacker.Team == target.Team
		or player:GetAttribute("MatchId") ~= sessionId or victim:GetAttribute("MatchId") ~= sessionId
		or type(eliminationId) ~= "string" or string.sub(eliminationId, 1, #prefix) ~= prefix then
		return 0, self:GetCoins(player)
	end
	local amount = Config.Economy.KillRewardCoins
	if type(amount) ~= "number" or amount ~= amount or amount < 0 or amount % 1 ~= 0 or amount == math.huge then
		warn("[PlayerService] Invalid Economy.KillRewardCoins")
		return 0, self:GetCoins(player)
	end
	local balance, credited = self:AddCoins(player, amount, "SlapElimination", "Kill:" .. eliminationId)
	return credited, balance
end

function PlayerService:GetCoins(player: any): number
	local data = self._data[player]
	return (data and data.Coins) or self._coins[player] or 0
end

-- Deduce monedas del jugador de forma server-authoritative (retorna éxito y nuevo balance)
function PlayerService:DeductCoins(player: any, amount: number, reason: string?): (boolean, number)
	if not player or amount <= 0 then
		return false, self:GetCoins(player)
	end

	local data = self._data[player]
	if not data then
		self:_register(player)
		data = self._data[player]
	end

	if data.Coins < amount then
		return false, data.Coins
	end

	local newBalance = data.Coins - amount
	data.Coins = newBalance
	self._coins[player] = newBalance

	local pName = if type(player) == "table" and player.Name then player.Name elseif typeof(player) == "Instance" then player.Name else tostring(player)
	print(string.format("[PlayerService] -%d Coins deducidos de '%s' (Razón: %s). Saldo restante: %d",
		amount, pName, reason or "ShopPurchase", newBalance))

	self:_sendDataUpdate(player)
	return true, newBalance
end

function PlayerService:AddWin(player: any, reason: string?): number
	if not player then return 0 end

	local data = self._data[player]
	if not data then
		self:_register(player)
		data = self._data[player]
	end

	data.Wins += 1
	local pName = if type(player) == "table" and player.Name then player.Name elseif typeof(player) == "Instance" then player.Name else tostring(player)
	print(string.format("[PlayerService] +1 Win otorgado a '%s' (Razón: %s). Total Wins: %d",
		pName, reason or "MatchWin", data.Wins))

	self:_sendDataUpdate(player)
	return data.Wins
end

function PlayerService:GetWins(player: any): number
	local data = self._data[player]
	return (data and data.Wins) or 0
end

function PlayerService:AddLoss(player: any, reason: string?): number
	if not player then return 0 end

	local data = self._data[player]
	if not data then
		self:_register(player)
		data = self._data[player]
	end

	data.Losses += 1
	local pName = if type(player) == "table" and player.Name then player.Name elseif typeof(player) == "Instance" then player.Name else tostring(player)
	print(string.format("[PlayerService] +1 Loss registrado a '%s' (Razón: %s). Total Losses: %d",
		pName, reason or "MatchLoss", data.Losses))

	self:_sendDataUpdate(player)
	return data.Losses
end

function PlayerService:GetLosses(player: any): number
	local data = self._data[player]
	return (data and data.Losses) or 0
end

-- Stats-only API. Kill money requires AwardConfirmedKill and its elimination transaction key.
function PlayerService:AddKill(player: any, amount: number?, reason: string?): (number, number)
	if not player then return 0, 0 end
	local addAmt = amount or 1
	if addAmt <= 0 then
		return self:GetKills(player), 0
	end

	local data = self._data[player]
	if not data then
		self:_register(player)
		data = self._data[player]
	end

	data.Kills = (data.Kills or 0) + addAmt
	self._kills[player] = data.Kills

	local pName = if type(player) == "table" and player.Name then player.Name elseif typeof(player) == "Instance" then player.Name else tostring(player)
	print(string.format("[PlayerService] +%d Kill(s) registrado a '%s' (Razón: %s). Total Kills: %d",
		addAmt, pName, reason or "Elimination", data.Kills))

	local ok, failure = pcall(self._sendDataUpdate, self, player)
	if not ok then warn("[PlayerService] Kill registered; data notification failed: " .. tostring(failure)) end
	return data.Kills, 0
end

function PlayerService:GetKills(player: any): number
	local data = self._data[player]
	return (data and data.Kills) or self._kills[player] or 0
end

function PlayerService:GetPlayerData(player: any): PlayerData
	local data = self._data[player]
	if data then
		return {
			Coins = data.Coins,
			Wins = data.Wins,
			Losses = data.Losses,
			Kills = data.Kills or 0,
			Inventory = data.Inventory,
		}
	end
	return {
		Coins = self:GetCoins(player),
		Wins = 0,
		Losses = 0,
		Kills = 0,
		Inventory = {
			Owned = {
				["PointEffects"] = { [PointEffectDefinitions.DefaultEffectId] = true },
				["DeathEffects"] = { [DeathSettings.DefaultKillEffectId] = true },
			},
			Equipped = {
				["PointEffects"] = PointEffectDefinitions.DefaultEffectId,
				["DeathEffects"] = DeathSettings.DefaultKillEffectId,
			},
		},
	}
end

-- Obtiene el inventario completo del jugador
function PlayerService:IsShopDataReady(player: any): boolean
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") or player.Parent ~= Players or not self._data[player] then return false end
	local pds = self:_getPlayerDataService()
	return pds ~= nil and pds:GetLoadState(player) == "Loaded"
end

function PlayerService:GetInventory(player: any): Types.PlayerInventory?
	local data = self._data[player]
	if not data then return nil end
	return data.Inventory
end

-- Verifica si el jugador posee un ítem en una categoría específica
function PlayerService:HasItem(player: any, category: string, productId: string): boolean
	if not player or type(category) ~= "string" or type(productId) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end

	-- Regla especial universal: PointEffects.Basic siempre es poseído
	if category == "PointEffects" and productId == PointEffectDefinitions.DefaultEffectId then
		return true
	end
	-- Initial entitlement, never a purchase/grant event or Coins transaction.
	if category == "DeathEffects" and productId == DeathSettings.DefaultKillEffectId then return true end

	local data = self._data[player]
	if not data or not data.Inventory or not data.Inventory.Owned then
		return false
	end

	local catOwned = data.Inventory.Owned[category]
	return catOwned ~= nil and catOwned[productId] == true
end

-- Otorga propiedad de un ítem en una categoría genérica (server-authoritative)
function PlayerService:AddItem(player: any, category: string, productId: string): (boolean, string?)
	if not player then
		return false, "PlayerNotFound"
	end
	if type(category) ~= "string" or category == "" then
		return false, "InvalidCategory"
	end
	if type(productId) ~= "string" or productId == "" then
		return false, "InvalidProductId"
	end

	local data = self._data[player]
	if not data then
		self:_register(player)
		data = self._data[player]
	end

	if not data.Inventory then
		data.Inventory = { Owned = {}, Equipped = {} }
	end
	if not data.Inventory.Owned then
		data.Inventory.Owned = {}
	end
	if not data.Inventory.Owned[category] then
		data.Inventory.Owned[category] = {}
	end

	data.Inventory.Owned[category][productId] = true

	-- Mantener referencias auxiliares de PointEffects sincronizadas
	if category == "PointEffects" then
		self._ownedPointEffects[player] = data.Inventory.Owned[category]
	end

	local pName = if type(player) == "table" and player.Name then player.Name elseif typeof(player) == "Instance" then player.Name else tostring(player)
	print(string.format("[PlayerService] Jugador '%s' adquirió ítem: [%s] '%s'", pName, category, productId))

	self:_sendDataUpdate(player)
	return true, nil
end

-- Retorna el ítem equipado actualmente en una categoría
function PlayerService:GetEquippedItem(player: any, category: string): string?
	if not player or type(category) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	if category == "DeathEffects" then
		local shop = self._context and self._context:GetService("ShopService")
		local provider = shop and shop:GetProvider(category)
		return if provider then provider:GetEquippedEffectId(player) else DeathSettings.DefaultKillEffectId
	end

	local data = self._data[player]
	if not data or not data.Inventory or not data.Inventory.Equipped then
		if category == "PointEffects" then
			return PointEffectDefinitions.DefaultEffectId
		end
		return nil
	end

	local equipped = data.Inventory.Equipped[category]

	if category == "PointEffects" then
		local models = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild("PointEffects")
		local model = equipped and models and models:FindFirstChild(equipped)
		if not equipped or not PointEffectDefinitions.IsValid(equipped) or not self:HasItem(player, category, equipped)
			or not model or not model:IsA("Model") then
			return PointEffectDefinitions.DefaultEffectId
		end
		return equipped
	end

	if equipped and not self:HasItem(player, category, equipped) then
		return nil
	end

	return equipped
end

-- Equipa un ítem en una categoría (valida propiedad y disponibilidad)
function PlayerService:SetEquippedItem(player: any, category: string, productId: string?): (boolean, string?)
	if not player then
		return false, "PlayerNotFound"
	end
	if type(category) ~= "string" or category == "" then
		return false, "InvalidCategory"
	end
	if category == "DeathEffects" then
		if not self:IsShopDataReady(player) then return false, "DataNotLoaded" end
		local shop = self._context and self._context:GetService("ShopService")
		local provider = shop and shop:GetProvider(category)
		local actualId = if productId and productId ~= "" then productId else DeathSettings.DefaultKillEffectId
		local product = provider and provider:GetProduct(actualId)
		if not product then return false, "ProductNotFound" end
		if not provider:GetResource(actualId) then return false, "ProductUnavailable" end
	end
	if category == "PointEffects" and productId and productId ~= "" then
		if not PointEffectDefinitions.IsValid(productId) then return false, "ProductNotFound" end
		local models = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild("PointEffects")
		local model = models and models:FindFirstChild(productId)
		if not model or not model:IsA("Model") then return false, "ProductUnavailable" end
	end

	local data = self._data[player]
	if not data then
		self:_register(player)
		data = self._data[player]
	end

	if not data.Inventory then
		data.Inventory = { Owned = {}, Equipped = {} }
	end
	if not data.Inventory.Equipped then
		data.Inventory.Equipped = {}
	end

	if productId == nil or productId == "" then
		return self:UnequipItem(player, category)
	end

	if not self:HasItem(player, category, productId) then
		warn(string.format("[PlayerService] Jugador no posee el ítem: [%s] '%s'", category, productId))
		return false, "NotOwned"
	end

	data.Inventory.Equipped[category] = productId

	if category == "PointEffects" then
		self._equippedPointEffects[player] = productId
	end

	local pName = if type(player) == "table" and player.Name then player.Name elseif typeof(player) == "Instance" then player.Name else tostring(player)
	print(string.format("[PlayerService] Jugador '%s' equipó ítem: [%s] '%s'", pName, category, productId))

	self:_sendDataUpdate(player)
	return true, nil
end

-- Desequipa el ítem de una categoría (restituye default seguro si aplica)
function PlayerService:UnequipItem(player: any, category: string): (boolean, string?)
	if not player then
		return false, "PlayerNotFound"
	end
	if type(category) ~= "string" or category == "" then
		return false, "InvalidCategory"
	end

	local data = self._data[player]
	if not data or not data.Inventory then
		return false, "NoInventory"
	end
	if not data.Inventory.Equipped then
		data.Inventory.Equipped = {}
	end

	if category == "PointEffects" then
		data.Inventory.Equipped["PointEffects"] = PointEffectDefinitions.DefaultEffectId
		self._equippedPointEffects[player] = PointEffectDefinitions.DefaultEffectId
	elseif category == "DeathEffects" then
		return self:SetEquippedItem(player, category, DeathSettings.DefaultKillEffectId)
	else
		data.Inventory.Equipped[category] = nil
	end

	local pName = if type(player) == "table" and player.Name then player.Name elseif typeof(player) == "Instance" then player.Name else tostring(player)
	print(string.format("[PlayerService] Jugador '%s' desequipó categoría: [%s]", pName, category))

	self:_sendDataUpdate(player)
	return true, nil
end

-- Verifica si el jugador posee un PointEffect específico
function PlayerService:HasPointEffect(player: any, effectId: string): boolean
	return self:HasItem(player, "PointEffects", effectId)
end

-- Retorna el diccionario de efectos que posee el jugador
function PlayerService:GetOwnedPointEffects(player: any): { [string]: boolean }
	local inv = self:GetInventory(player)
	local owned = (inv and inv.Owned and inv.Owned["PointEffects"]) or {}
	local copy = { [PointEffectDefinitions.DefaultEffectId] = true }
	for k, v in pairs(owned) do
		copy[k] = v
	end
	return copy
end

-- Agrega un efecto a la lista de efectos poseídos (wrapper compatible)
function PlayerService:AddOwnedPointEffect(player: any, effectId: string): (boolean, string?)
	if not PointEffectDefinitions.IsValid(effectId) then
		return false, "InvalidEffectId"
	end
	return self:AddItem(player, "PointEffects", effectId)
end

-- Retorna el PointEffect equipado por el jugador (con fallback seguro obligatorio a Basic)
function PlayerService:GetEquippedPointEffect(player: any): string
	return self:GetEquippedItem(player, "PointEffects") or PointEffectDefinitions.DefaultEffectId
end

-- Equipa autoritativamente un PointEffect para el jugador (wrapper compatible)
function PlayerService:SetEquippedPointEffect(player: any, effectId: string): (boolean, string?)
	if not PointEffectDefinitions.IsValid(effectId) then
		warn(string.format("[PlayerService] Intento de equipar effectId inexistente: '%s'", tostring(effectId)))
		return false, "InvalidEffectId"
	end
	return self:SetEquippedItem(player, "PointEffects", effectId)
end

function PlayerService:Start(context)
	self._context = context
	table.insert(self._connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		self:_register(player)
	end))
	table.insert(self._connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		self:_unregister(player)
	end))

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		self:_register(player)
	end
end

return PlayerService

--!strict
-- PlayerDataService
-- Capa de persistencia autoritativa mediante el proveedor seleccionado al arrancar.
-- Gestiona el ciclo de vida de persistencia (Load, Save, BindToClose, Retries, Validación).
-- No contiene lógica económica de gameplay (responsabilidad de PlayerService).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Types = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Types)
local DeathSettings = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.DeathFeedbackConfig).DeathEffects

type PlayerData = Types.PlayerData
type PlayerDataRecord = Types.PlayerDataRecord
type DataLoadState = Types.DataLoadState

local PlayerDataService = {}
PlayerDataService.Name = "PlayerDataService"

PlayerDataService._context = nil :: any
PlayerDataService._store = nil :: any
PlayerDataService._persistenceInfo = nil :: any
PlayerDataService._loadStates = {} :: { [Player]: DataLoadState }
PlayerDataService._saving = {} :: { [Player]: boolean }
PlayerDataService._bindToCloseConnected = false
PlayerDataService._playerService = nil :: any

-- Función auxiliar para verificar números finitos válidos y no-NaN
local function isValidNumber(val: any): boolean
	return typeof(val) == "number" and val == val and math.abs(val) ~= math.huge
end

-- Función auxiliar para generar Inventory por defecto
local function getDefaultInventory(): Types.PlayerInventory
	return {
		Owned = {
			["PointEffects"] = { ["Basic"] = true },
			["DeathEffects"] = { [DeathSettings.DefaultKillEffectId] = true },
		},
		Equipped = {
			["PointEffects"] = "Basic",
			["DeathEffects"] = DeathSettings.DefaultKillEffectId,
		},
	}
end

-- Sanitiza y valida profundamente una estructura de Inventory
local function sanitizeInventory(rawInv: any, warnings: { string }): Types.PlayerInventory
	if type(rawInv) ~= "table" then
		table.insert(warnings, "Inventory is not a table, generated default Inventory")
		return getDefaultInventory()
	end

	local sanitizedOwned: { [string]: { [string]: boolean } } = {}
	local rawOwned = rawInv.Owned
	if type(rawOwned) == "table" then
		for category, items in pairs(rawOwned) do
			if type(category) == "string" and type(items) == "table" then
				local catItems: { [string]: boolean } = {}
				for itemId, isOwned in pairs(items) do
					if type(itemId) == "string" and isOwned == true then
						catItems[itemId] = true
					end
				end
				sanitizedOwned[category] = catItems
			end
		end
	else
		table.insert(warnings, "Inventory.Owned is not a table, initialized empty Owned")
	end

	-- Regla arquitectónica: PointEffects.Basic siempre debe existir
	if not sanitizedOwned["PointEffects"] then
		sanitizedOwned["PointEffects"] = {}
	end
	sanitizedOwned["PointEffects"]["Basic"] = true
	-- Additive initial entitlement within the existing schema; preserve all owned future effects.
	sanitizedOwned["DeathEffects"] = sanitizedOwned["DeathEffects"] or {}
	sanitizedOwned["DeathEffects"][DeathSettings.DefaultKillEffectId] = true

	local sanitizedEquipped: { [string]: string? } = {}
	local rawEquipped = rawInv.Equipped
	if type(rawEquipped) == "table" then
		for category, equippedId in pairs(rawEquipped) do
			if type(category) == "string" and type(equippedId) == "string" then
				-- Verificar que el ítem realmente se posea en su categoría
				if sanitizedOwned[category] and sanitizedOwned[category][equippedId] == true then
					sanitizedEquipped[category] = equippedId
				else
					table.insert(warnings, string.format("Equipped item '%s' in category '%s' not owned, unequipped", equippedId, category))
				end
			end
		end
	else
		table.insert(warnings, "Inventory.Equipped is not a table, initialized empty Equipped")
	end

	-- Regla arquitectónica: PointEffects.Equipped fallback seguro obligatorio a Basic
	if not sanitizedEquipped["PointEffects"] or not sanitizedOwned["PointEffects"][sanitizedEquipped["PointEffects"]] then
		sanitizedEquipped["PointEffects"] = "Basic"
	end
	if not sanitizedEquipped["DeathEffects"] or sanitizedEquipped["DeathEffects"] == DeathSettings.DefaultFallEffectId then
		sanitizedEquipped["DeathEffects"] = DeathSettings.DefaultKillEffectId
	end

	return {
		Owned = sanitizedOwned,
		Equipped = sanitizedEquipped,
	}
end

-- ==================================================
-- VALIDACIÓN CENTRAL DE DATOS
-- ==================================================

function PlayerDataService:ValidatePlayerData(raw: any): (boolean, PlayerDataRecord, string?)
	local defaultInv = getDefaultInventory()
	if type(raw) ~= "table" then
		return false, {
			Version = Config.DataStore.CurrentVersion or 2,
			Coins = Config.Economy.StartingCoins or 0,
			Wins = Config.Economy.StartingWins or 0,
			Losses = Config.Economy.StartingLosses or 0,
			Kills = Config.Economy.StartingKills or 0,
			Inventory = defaultInv,
		}, "Raw data is not a table"
	end

	local warnings: { string } = {}

	local version = raw.Version
	local currentVersion = (Config.DataStore and Config.DataStore.CurrentVersion) or 2
	if not isValidNumber(version) or version < 1 then
		table.insert(warnings, string.format("Invalid or missing Version (%s), migrating to %d", tostring(version), currentVersion))
		version = currentVersion
	elseif version < currentVersion then
		table.insert(warnings, string.format("Migrating PlayerData from version %d to %d", version, currentVersion))
		version = currentVersion
	elseif version > currentVersion then
		local errMsg = string.format("IncompatibleVersion: Data version (%d) is newer than current config (%d)", version, currentVersion)
		warn(string.format("[PlayerData] %s. Normalización y guardado bloqueados para prevenir corrupción de esquema futuro.", errMsg))
		return false, raw, errMsg
	end

	-- Coins
	local coins = raw.Coins
	if not isValidNumber(coins) or coins < 0 then
		table.insert(warnings, string.format("Invalid Coins (%s), fallback to 0", tostring(coins)))
		coins = 0
	else
		coins = math.floor(coins)
	end

	-- Wins
	local wins = raw.Wins
	if not isValidNumber(wins) or wins < 0 then
		table.insert(warnings, string.format("Invalid Wins (%s), fallback to 0", tostring(wins)))
		wins = 0
	else
		wins = math.floor(wins)
	end

	-- Losses
	local losses = raw.Losses
	if not isValidNumber(losses) or losses < 0 then
		table.insert(warnings, string.format("Invalid Losses (%s), fallback to 0", tostring(losses)))
		losses = 0
	else
		losses = math.floor(losses)
	end

	-- Kills (retrocompatible: perfiles anteriores sin Kills reciben fallback a 0)
	local kills = raw.Kills
	if not isValidNumber(kills) or kills < 0 then
		table.insert(warnings, string.format("Invalid or missing Kills (%s), fallback to 0", tostring(kills)))
		kills = 0
	else
		kills = math.floor(kills)
	end

	-- Inventory (Migración y sanitización profunda)
	local inventory = sanitizeInventory(raw.Inventory, warnings)

	local validatedRecord: PlayerDataRecord = {
		Version = Config.DataStore.CurrentVersion or 2,
		Coins = coins,
		Wins = wins,
		Losses = losses,
		Kills = kills,
		Inventory = inventory,
		LastSaved = raw.LastSaved,
	}

	local warningMsg = if #warnings > 0 then table.concat(warnings, "; ") else nil
	return true, validatedRecord, warningMsg
end

function PlayerDataService:Init(context: any)
	self._context = context
	self._loadStates = {}
	self._saving = {}
	self._store = context and context.PersistenceProvider or nil
	self._persistenceInfo = context and context.PersistenceInfo or nil

	if not self._store then
		local reason = self._persistenceInfo and self._persistenceInfo.BlockedReason or "ProviderMissing"
		warn(string.format("[PlayerData] Persistencia no disponible; acceso cloud bloqueado (%s)", tostring(reason)))
	end

	-- BindToClose seguro con espera activa de guardados
	if not self._bindToCloseConnected then
		self._bindToCloseConnected = true
		game:BindToClose(function()
			print("[PlayerData] BindToClose: Guardando datos de todos los jugadores...")
			self:SaveAllPlayers()
			print("[PlayerData] BindToClose: Finalizado.")
		end)
	end
end

function PlayerDataService:Start(context: any)
	print("[PlayerDataService] Servicio de persistencia iniciado y listo")
end

function PlayerDataService:GetStore(): any
	-- La selección es fija durante toda la vida del servidor. Nunca realizar
	-- fallback automático a DataStoreService si el proveedor está ausente o falla.
	return self._store
end

function PlayerDataService:GetPersistenceDiagnostics(): { [string]: any }
	local result = {
		Environment = self._persistenceInfo and self._persistenceInfo.Environment or "Unknown",
		ProviderName = self._persistenceInfo and self._persistenceInfo.ProviderName or "Unavailable",
		WritesToCloud = self._persistenceInfo and self._persistenceInfo.WritesToCloud == true or false,
		GameId = self._persistenceInfo and self._persistenceInfo.GameId or game.GameId,
		PlaceId = self._persistenceInfo and self._persistenceInfo.PlaceId or game.PlaceId,
		BlockedReason = self._persistenceInfo and self._persistenceInfo.BlockedReason or nil,
	}

	if self._store and type(self._store.GetDiagnostics) == "function" then
		for key, value in pairs(self._store:GetDiagnostics()) do
			result[key] = value
		end
	end
	return result
end

function PlayerDataService:GetLoadState(player: Player): DataLoadState?
	return self._loadStates[player]
end

function PlayerDataService:SetLoadState(player: Player, state: DataLoadState)
	self._loadStates[player] = state

function PlayerDataService:LoadPlayer(player: Player): (boolean, PlayerDataRecord?, string?)
	if not player or not player:IsA("Player") then
		return false, nil, "InvalidPlayerInstance"
	end

	self._loadStates[player] = "Loading"

	local store = self:GetStore()
	if not store then
		self._loadStates[player] = "Failed"
		warn(string.format("[PlayerData] Load failed: DataStore no disponible para '%s'", player.Name))
		return false, nil, "DataStoreNotAvailable"
	end

	local key = string.format("Player_%d", player.UserId)
	local maxRetries = (Config.DataStore and Config.DataStore.MaxRetries) or 3
	local retryDelay = (Config.DataStore and Config.DataStore.InitialRetryDelay) or 1.0
	local backoff = (Config.DataStore and Config.DataStore.RetryBackoffMultiplier) or 2.0

	local lastErr: any = nil
	for attempt = 1, maxRetries do
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync(key)
		end)

		if ok then
			if result == nil then
				-- Jugador nuevo sin datos previos
				local newRecord: PlayerDataRecord = {
					Version = (Config.DataStore and Config.DataStore.CurrentVersion) or 2,
					Coins = (Config.Economy and Config.Economy.StartingCoins) or 0,
					Wins = (Config.Economy and Config.Economy.StartingWins) or 0,
					Losses = (Config.Economy and Config.Economy.StartingLosses) or 0,
					Kills = (Config.Economy and Config.Economy.StartingKills) or 0,
					Inventory = getDefaultInventory(),
				}
				self._loadStates[player] = "Loaded"
				print(string.format("[PlayerData] Load success (Nuevo jugador): '%s' (UserId: %d)", player.Name, player.UserId))
				return true, newRecord, nil
			else
				local valid, validatedRecord, warnMsg = self:ValidatePlayerData(result)
				if not valid then
					if type(result) == "table" and isValidNumber(result.Version) and result.Version > ((Config.DataStore and Config.DataStore.CurrentVersion) or 2) then
						self._loadStates[player] = "IncompatibleVersion"
						warn(string.format("[PlayerData] Load rejected para '%s': Versión de datos incompatible (%d > %d). Guardado bloqueado.",
							player.Name, result.Version, (Config.DataStore and Config.DataStore.CurrentVersion) or 2))
						return false, nil, warnMsg or "IncompatibleVersion"
					else
						self._loadStates[player] = "Corrupted"
						warn(string.format("[PlayerData] Load rejected para '%s': Datos corruptos (%s)", player.Name, tostring(warnMsg)))
						return false, nil, warnMsg or "ValidationFailed"
					end
				end

				if warnMsg then
					warn(string.format("[PlayerData] Advertencia en datos de '%s': %s", player.Name, warnMsg))
				end
				self._loadStates[player] = "Loaded"
				print(string.format("[PlayerData] Load success: '%s' (Coins=%d, Wins=%d, Losses=%d)",
					player.Name, validatedRecord.Coins, validatedRecord.Wins, validatedRecord.Losses))
				return true, validatedRecord, nil
			end
		else
			lastErr = result
			print(string.format("[PlayerData] Load retry %d/%d para '%s': %s", attempt, maxRetries, player.Name, tostring(result)))
			if attempt < maxRetries then
				task.wait(retryDelay)
				retryDelay *= backoff
			end
		end
	end

	self._loadStates[player] = "Failed"
	warn(string.format("[PlayerData] Load failed definitivo para '%s' tras %d intentos: %s", player.Name, maxRetries, tostring(lastErr)))
	return false, nil, tostring(lastErr)
end

function PlayerDataService:SavePlayer(player: Player, runtimeData: PlayerData?): (boolean, string?)
	if not player or not player:IsA("Player") then
		return false, "InvalidPlayerInstance"
	end

	-- SEGURIDAD CRÍTICA: Si el jugador no cargó correctamente, NUNCA guardar para no corromper ni sobrescribir
	local loadState = self._loadStates[player]
	if loadState == "IncompatibleVersion" then
		warn(string.format("[PlayerData] RECHAZO DE GUARDADO para '%s': Versión de datos en DataStore es incompatible (%s). Guardado bloqueado para proteger datos futuros.",
			player.Name, tostring(loadState)))
		return false, "IncompatibleVersion"
	end

	if loadState ~= "Loaded" then
		warn(string.format("[PlayerData] RECHAZO DE GUARDADO para '%s': Estado no es 'Loaded' (Estado actual: %s). Protección contra pérdida de datos activada.",
			player.Name, tostring(loadState)))
		return false, "DataNotLoaded"
	end

	if not runtimeData then
		warn(string.format("[PlayerData] RECHAZO DE GUARDADO para '%s': runtimeData es nil", player.Name))
		return false, "NilRuntimeData"
	end

	-- Protección contra guardado simultáneo del mismo jugador
	if self._saving[player] then
		-- Esperar de forma controlada si ya hay un guardado en curso
		local waitAttempts = 0
		while self._saving[player] and waitAttempts < 40 do
			task.wait(0.05)
			waitAttempts += 1
		end
		if self._saving[player] then
			warn(string.format("[PlayerData] Guardado concurrente en curso para '%s', abortando solicitud duplicada", player.Name))
			return false, "AlreadySaving"
		end
	end

	self._saving[player] = true

	local store = self:GetStore()
	if not store then
		self._saving[player] = nil
		warn(string.format("[PlayerData] Save failed: DataStore no disponible para '%s'", player.Name))
		return false, "DataStoreNotAvailable"
	end

	local key = string.format("Player_%d", player.UserId)
	local maxRetries = (Config.DataStore and Config.DataStore.MaxRetries) or 3
	local retryDelay = (Config.DataStore and Config.DataStore.InitialRetryDelay) or 1.0
	local backoff = (Config.DataStore and Config.DataStore.RetryBackoffMultiplier) or 2.0

	local payload: PlayerDataRecord = {
		Version = (Config.DataStore and Config.DataStore.CurrentVersion) or 2,
		Coins = math.max(0, math.floor(runtimeData.Coins or 0)),
		Wins = math.max(0, math.floor(runtimeData.Wins or 0)),
		Losses = math.max(0, math.floor(runtimeData.Losses or 0)),
		Kills = math.max(0, math.floor(runtimeData.Kills or 0)),
		Inventory = runtimeData.Inventory or getDefaultInventory(),
		LastSaved = os.time(),
	}

	local lastErr: any = nil
	local wasVersionAborted = false
	for attempt = 1, maxRetries do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			store:UpdateAsync(key, function(oldData: any)
				-- Mantener posibles campos externos futuros si existen
				if type(oldData) == "table" then
					local currentVersion = (Config.DataStore and Config.DataStore.CurrentVersion) or 2
					if isValidNumber(oldData.Version) and oldData.Version > currentVersion then
						wasVersionAborted = true
						return nil -- Cancela la escritura atómica en DataStore sin alterar los datos remotos
					end

					local updated = table.clone(oldData)
					updated.Version = payload.Version
					updated.Coins = payload.Coins
					updated.Wins = payload.Wins
					updated.Losses = payload.Losses
					updated.Kills = payload.Kills
					updated.Inventory = payload.Inventory
					updated.LastSaved = payload.LastSaved
					return updated
				end
				return payload
			end)
		end)

		if wasVersionAborted then
			self._saving[player] = nil
			self._loadStates[player] = "IncompatibleVersion"
			warn(string.format("[PlayerData] Save abortado para '%s': Versión remota en DataStore es superior a la versión soportada (%d).",
				player.Name, (Config.DataStore and Config.DataStore.CurrentVersion) or 2))
			return false, "IncompatibleVersion"
		end

		if ok then
			self._saving[player] = nil
			print(string.format("[PlayerData] Save success: '%s' (Coins=%d, Wins=%d, Losses=%d, Kills=%d)",
				player.Name, payload.Coins, payload.Wins, payload.Losses, payload.Kills))
			return true, nil
		else
			lastErr = err
			print(string.format("[PlayerData] Save retry %d/%d para '%s': %s", attempt, maxRetries, player.Name, tostring(err)))
			if attempt < maxRetries then
				task.wait(retryDelay)
				retryDelay *= backoff
			end
		end
	end

	self._saving[player] = nil
	warn(string.format("[PlayerData] Save failed definitivo para '%s' tras %d intentos: %s", player.Name, maxRetries, tostring(lastErr)))
	return false, tostring(lastErr)
end

function PlayerDataService:_getPlayerService(): any
	if self._playerService then
		return self._playerService
	end
	if self._context and type(self._context.GetService) == "function" then
		local s = self._context:GetService("PlayerService")
		if s then
			self._playerService = s
			return s
		end
	end
	local ok, mod = pcall(require, script.Parent.PlayerService)
	if ok and mod then
		self._playerService = mod
		return mod
	end
	return nil
end

-- GUARDADO COLECTIVO (BINDTOCLOSE / SHUTDOWN)
-- ==================================================

function PlayerDataService:SaveAllPlayers(): (number, number)
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	if #players == 0 then
		return 0, 0
	end

	local playerService = self:_getPlayerService()
	local remaining = #players
	local savedCount = 0
	local failedCount = 0

	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		task.spawn(function()
			local runtimeData: PlayerData? = nil
			if playerService and type(playerService.GetPlayerData) == "function" then
				runtimeData = playerService:GetPlayerData(player)
			end

			local success = false
			if runtimeData and self._loadStates[player] == "Loaded" then
				local ok = self:SavePlayer(player, runtimeData)
				success = ok
			else
				print(string.format("[PlayerData] SaveAllPlayers: Omitiendo '%s' (no cargado o sin datos runtime)", player.Name))
			end

			if success then
				savedCount += 1
			else
				failedCount += 1
			end
			remaining -= 1
		end)
	end

	-- Esperar hasta que todos los hilos terminen o timeout de seguridad de 25 segundos
	local timeout = 25
	local elapsed = 0
	while remaining > 0 and elapsed < timeout do
		task.wait(0.1)
		elapsed += 0.1
	end

	print(string.format("[PlayerData] SaveAllPlayers completado: %d guardados, %d omitidos/fallidos", savedCount, failedCount))
	return savedCount, failedCount
end

-- Limpieza de estado auxiliar al salir
function PlayerDataService:Cleanup(player: Player)
	self._loadStates[player] = nil
	self._saving[player] = nil
end

return PlayerDataService

-- ShopRegistry
-- Registro en memoria de ProductProviders y resolución desacoplada de catálogos.
-- Completamente agnóstico respecto a categorías concretas (no contiene lógica hardcodeada).

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Types = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Types)

type ProductDefinition = Types.ProductDefinition
type ProductProvider = Types.ProductProvider

local ShopRegistry = {}

ShopRegistry._providers = {} :: { [string]: ProductProvider }
ShopRegistry._productsById = {} :: { [string]: ProductDefinition }
ShopRegistry._productsByRobloxId = {} :: { [number]: ProductDefinition }

-- ==================================================
-- VALIDACIÓN Y REGISTRO DE PROVIDERS
-- ==================================================

-- Registra un ProductProvider e indexa sus productos en el catálogo unificado
function ShopRegistry:Register(provider: ProductProvider)
	assert(type(provider) == "table", "[ShopRegistry] El proveedor debe ser una tabla")

	-- Validación estricta del contrato de métodos de ProductProvider
	assert(type(provider.GetCategory) == "function", "[ShopRegistry] Proveedor no implementa GetCategory()")
	assert(type(provider.GetProducts) == "function", "[ShopRegistry] Proveedor no implementa GetProducts()")
	assert(type(provider.GetProduct) == "function", "[ShopRegistry] Proveedor no implementa GetProduct()")
	assert(type(provider.CanPurchase) == "function", "[ShopRegistry] Proveedor no implementa CanPurchase()")
	assert(type(provider.CanEquip) == "function", "[ShopRegistry] Proveedor no implementa CanEquip()")
	assert(type(provider.OnPurchased) == "function", "[ShopRegistry] Proveedor no implementa OnPurchased()")
	assert(type(provider.OnEquipped) == "function", "[ShopRegistry] Proveedor no implementa OnEquipped()")
	assert(type(provider.OnUnequipped) == "function", "[ShopRegistry] Proveedor no implementa OnUnequipped()")

	local category = provider:GetCategory()
	assert(type(category) == "string" and category ~= "", "[ShopRegistry] GetCategory() debe retornar un string no vacío")
	assert(self._providers[category] == nil, string.format("[ShopRegistry] Categoría duplicada: el proveedor para '%s' ya está registrado", category))

	local products = provider:GetProducts()
	assert(type(products) == "table", string.format("[ShopRegistry] GetProducts() para '%s' debe retornar una tabla", category))

	-- Validación e indexación de cada producto del proveedor
	for _, product in ipairs(products) do
		assert(type(product) == "table", string.format("[ShopRegistry] Producto inválido encontrado en la categoría '%s'", category))
		assert(type(product.Id) == "string" and product.Id ~= "", string.format("[ShopRegistry] Producto sin Id válido en la categoría '%s'", category))
		assert(product.Category == category, string.format("[ShopRegistry] Category del producto '%s' ('%s') no coincide con la categoría del provider ('%s')", product.Id, tostring(product.Category), category))
		assert(product.ProductType == "Cosmetic" or product.ProductType == "Consumable", string.format("[ShopRegistry] ProductType inválido ('%s') en el producto '%s'. Debe ser 'Cosmetic' o 'Consumable'", tostring(product.ProductType), product.Id))
		assert(type(product.DisplayName) == "string" and product.DisplayName ~= "", string.format("[ShopRegistry] DisplayName inválido en el producto '%s'", product.Id))
		assert(type(product.Price) == "number" and product.Price >= 0, string.format("[ShopRegistry] Price inválido (debe ser >= 0) en el producto '%s'", product.Id))
		assert(product.Currency == "Coins" or product.Currency == "Robux", string.format("[ShopRegistry] Currency inválido ('%s') en el producto '%s'. Debe ser 'Coins' o 'Robux'", tostring(product.Currency), product.Id))
		assert(type(product.IsAvailable) == "boolean", string.format("[ShopRegistry] IsAvailable debe ser booleano en el producto '%s'", product.Id))

		if product.Currency == "Robux" then
			assert(type(product.RobloxProductId) == "number" and product.RobloxProductId > 0, string.format("[ShopRegistry] Producto Robux '%s' requiere un RobloxProductId numérico positivo obligatorio", product.Id))
		end

		assert(self._productsById[product.Id] == nil, string.format("[ShopRegistry] Id de producto duplicado detectado: '%s'", product.Id))

		self._productsById[product.Id] = product
		if product.RobloxProductId then
			self._productsByRobloxId[product.RobloxProductId] = product
		end
	end

	self._providers[category] = provider
	print(string.format("[ShopRegistry] Proveedor registrado exitosamente para la categoría '%s' (%d productos indexados)", category, #products))
end

-- ==================================================
-- CONSULTA Y RESOLUCIÓN
-- ==================================================

-- Retorna el ProductProvider registrado para una categoría
function ShopRegistry:GetProvider(category: string): ProductProvider?
	if type(category) ~= "string" or category == "" then
		return nil
	end
	return self._providers[category]
end

-- Retorna todos los proveedores registrados en un diccionario por categoría
function ShopRegistry:GetProviders(): { [string]: ProductProvider }
	local copy: { [string]: ProductProvider } = {}
	for category, provider in pairs(self._providers) do
		copy[category] = provider
	end
	return copy
end

-- Retorna la definición de un producto por su Id único
function ShopRegistry:GetProduct(productId: string): ProductDefinition?
	if type(productId) ~= "string" or productId == "" then
		return nil
	end
	return self._productsById[productId]
end

-- Retorna la definición de un producto por su RobloxProductId oficial
function ShopRegistry:GetProductByRobloxId(robloxId: number): ProductDefinition?
	if type(robloxId) ~= "number" or robloxId <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return self._productsByRobloxId[robloxId]
end

-- Retorna el catálogo completo unificado de todos los productos registrados
function ShopRegistry:GetCatalog(): { ProductDefinition }
	local catalog: { ProductDefinition } = {}
	for _, product in pairs(self._productsById) do
		table.insert(catalog, product)
	end
	return catalog
end

-- Retorna los productos pertenecientes a una categoría específica
function ShopRegistry:GetCategoryProducts(category: string): { ProductDefinition }
	local provider = self:GetProvider(category)
	if not provider then
		return {}
	end
	return provider:GetProducts()
end

-- Verifica si existe un proveedor registrado para una categoría
function ShopRegistry:HasCategory(category: string): boolean
	return self._providers[category] ~= nil
end

-- Verifica si existe un producto registrado por su Id
function ShopRegistry:HasProduct(productId: string): boolean
	return self._productsById[productId] ~= nil
end

-- Limpia todos los proveedores y productos registrados (útil para pruebas o reinicialización)
function ShopRegistry:Clear()
	self._providers = {}
	self._productsById = {}
	self._productsByRobloxId = {}
end

return ShopRegistry

local function ensureChild(parent: Instance, name: string, className: string): Instance
	local existing = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing.ClassName == className then
		return existing
	end
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	inst.Name = name
	inst.Parent = parent
	return inst
end

local function isValidArg(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" and #value <= MAX_ARG_LENGTH
end

-- Rate-limit por jugador para operaciones que modifican estado
local function consumeRequest(player: Player): boolean
	local now = os.clock()
	local last = _lastRequest[player]
	if last and (now - last) < MIN_REQUEST_INTERVAL then
		return false
	end
	_lastRequest[player] = now
	return true
end

-- Ejecuta una operación de ShopService protegida contra errores internos
local function safeCall(fn: () -> (boolean, string?)): (boolean, string?)
	local ok, success, err = pcall(fn)
	if not ok then
		warn(string.format("[ShopRemotes] Error interno: %s", tostring(success)))
		return false, "InternalError"
	end
	return success == true, if success == true then nil else (err or "Failed")
end

	local getCatalog = ensureChild(shopFolder, "GetCatalog", "RemoteFunction") :: RemoteFunction
	local purchase = ensureChild(shopFolder, "PurchaseProduct", "RemoteFunction") :: RemoteFunction
	local equip = ensureChild(shopFolder, "EquipProduct", "RemoteFunction") :: RemoteFunction
	local unequip = ensureChild(shopFolder, "UnequipProduct", "RemoteFunction") :: RemoteFunction

	getCatalog.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player, category: any)
		local filter: string? = if isValidArg(category) then category else nil
		local ok, catalog = pcall(function()
			return _shopService:GetCatalog(filter)
		end)
		local result = {}
		if ok and type(catalog) == "table" then
			for _, product in ipairs(catalog) do
				table.insert(result, toPublicProduct(product))
			end
		else
			warn(string.format("[ShopRemotes] GetCatalog falló: %s", tostring(catalog)))
		end
		task.defer(pushDataSnapshot, player)
		return result
	end

	purchase.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player, productId: any)
		if not isValidArg(productId) then return false, "InvalidProductId" end
		if not consumeRequest(player) then return false, "RateLimited" end
		return safeCall(function()
			return _shopService:PurchaseProduct(player, productId)
		end)
	end

	equip.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player, productId: any)
		if not isValidArg(productId) then return false, "InvalidProductId" end
		if not consumeRequest(player) then return false, "RateLimited" end
		return safeCall(function()
			return _shopService:EquipProduct(player, productId)
		end)
	end

	unequip.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player, category: any)
		if not isValidArg(category) then return false, "InvalidCategory" end
		if not consumeRequest(player) then return false, "RateLimited" end
		return safeCall(function()
			return _shopService:UnequipProduct(player, category)
		end)
	end

	table.insert(_connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		_lastRequest[player] = nil
	end))

	print("[ShopRemotes] Remote API de tienda lista (GetCatalog, PurchaseProduct, EquipProduct, UnequipProduct)")
end

return ShopRemotes

local function attrColor(inst: Instance?, name: string, default: Color3): Color3
	local v = inst and inst:GetAttribute(name)
	if typeof(v) == "Color3" then
		return v
	end
	return default
end

local function find(parent: Instance?, path: { string }): Instance?
	local current = parent
	for _, name in ipairs(path) do
		if not current then return nil end
		current = current:FindFirstChild(name)
	end
	return current
end

local function formatNumber(n: number): string
	local s = tostring(math.floor(n))
	local formatted = s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1."):reverse()
	return (formatted:gsub("^%.", ""))
end

function ShopController:_bindHUD(): boolean
	local playerGui = localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	local hud = playerGui:WaitForChild("ShopHUD", REMOTE_TIMEOUT) :: ScreenGui?
	if not hud then
		warn("[ShopController] No se encontró ShopHUD en PlayerGui")

	end

	local main = hud:FindFirstChild("MainFrame") :: Frame?
	local catalog = find(main, { "Body", "Catalog" }) :: ScrollingFrame?
	local template = catalog and catalog:FindFirstChild("ProductCardTemplate") :: GuiButton?
	local detailFrame = find(main, { "Body", "DetailPanel" }) :: Frame?
	if not main or not catalog or not template or not detailFrame then
		warn("[ShopController] Estructura de ShopHUD incompleta (MainFrame/Body/Catalog/ProductCardTemplate/DetailPanel)")
		return false
	end

	template.Visible = false
	main.Visible = false

	self._ui = {
		Hud = hud,
		OpenButton = hud:FindFirstChild("ShopButton") :: GuiButton?,
		Main = main,
		OpenScale = main:FindFirstChild("OpenScale") :: UIScale?,
		CloseButton = find(main, { "Header", "CloseButton" }) :: GuiButton?,
		CoinsLabel = find(main, { "Header", "CoinsContainer", "CoinsLabel" }) :: TextLabel?,
		Tabs = main:FindFirstChild("Tabs") :: Frame?,
		Catalog = catalog,
		CardTemplate = template,
		EmptyState = find(main, { "Body", "EmptyState" }) :: GuiObject?,
		LoadingLabel = find(main, { "Body", "LoadingLabel" }) :: GuiObject?,
		MessageLabel = main:FindFirstChild("MessageLabel") :: TextLabel?,
		Detail = {
			Frame = detailFrame,
			PreviewLabel = find(detailFrame, { "Preview", "PreviewLabel" }) :: TextLabel?,
			PreviewIcon = find(detailFrame, { "Preview", "PreviewIcon" }) :: ImageLabel?,
			NameLabel = detailFrame:FindFirstChild("NameLabel") :: TextLabel?,
			RarityLabel = detailFrame:FindFirstChild("RarityLabel") :: TextLabel?,
			DescriptionLabel = detailFrame:FindFirstChild("DescriptionLabel") :: TextLabel?,
			PriceRow = detailFrame:FindFirstChild("PriceRow") :: GuiObject?,
			PriceLabel = find(detailFrame, { "PriceRow", "PriceLabel" }) :: TextLabel?,
			StatusLabel = detailFrame:FindFirstChild("StatusLabel") :: TextLabel?,
			ActionButton = detailFrame:FindFirstChild("ActionButton") :: TextButton?,
			SecondaryButton = detailFrame:FindFirstChild("SecondaryButton") :: TextButton?,
		},
	}

	local templateStroke = template:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if templateStroke then
		self._cardBaseStroke = { Color = templateStroke.Color, Thickness = templateStroke.Thickness }
	end

	-- Pestañas: cualquier GuiButton dentro de Tabs con atributo Category
	local tabsFrame = self._ui.Tabs
	if tabsFrame then
		for _, child in ipairs(tabsFrame:GetChildren()) do
			local category = child:GetAttribute("Category")
			if child:IsA("GuiButton") and typeof(category) == "string" then
				self._tabs[category] = child
				self._tabBaseColors[child] = child.BackgroundColor3
				if child:IsA("ImageButton") then self._tabBaseImageColors[child] = child.ImageColor3 end
				table.insert(self._connections, child.Activated:Connect(function()
					self:_selectCategory(category)
				end))
			end
		end
	end

	local ui = self._ui
	if ui.OpenButton then
		table.insert(self._connections, ui.OpenButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			self:Toggle()
		end))
	end
	if ui.CloseButton then
		table.insert(self._connections, ui.CloseButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			self:Close()
		end))
	end
	if ui.Detail.ActionButton then
		table.insert(self._connections, ui.Detail.ActionButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			self:_onActionPressed()
		end))
	end
	if ui.Detail.SecondaryButton then
		table.insert(self._connections, ui.Detail.SecondaryButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			self:_onSecondaryPressed()
		end))
	end

	return true
end

function ShopController:_bindRemotes()
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", REMOTE_TIMEOUT)
	local shopFolder = remotes and remotes:WaitForChild("Shop", REMOTE_TIMEOUT)
	if shopFolder then
		for _, name in ipairs({ "GetCatalog", "PurchaseProduct", "EquipProduct", "UnequipProduct" }) do
			local rf = shopFolder:WaitForChild(name, REMOTE_TIMEOUT)
			if rf and rf:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
				self._remotes[name] = rf
			else
				warn(string.format("[ShopController] RemoteFunction Shop.%s no disponible", name))
			end
		end
	end

	local playerFolder = remotes and remotes:WaitForChild("Player", REMOTE_TIMEOUT)
	local dataUpdated = playerFolder and playerFolder:WaitForChild("DataUpdated", REMOTE_TIMEOUT)
	if dataUpdated and dataUpdated:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		-- Se conecta de forma diferida en la primera apertura (ver _ensureDataListener)
		self._dataUpdated = dataUpdated
	else
		warn("[ShopController] RemoteEvent Player.DataUpdated no disponible")
	end
end

-- Conecta DataUpdated recién cuando el jugador abre la tienda.
-- Motivo: los eventos disparados antes de que exista un listener quedan encolados y se entregan al primer
-- handler que se conecta; conectar aquí evita robarle el snapshot inicial a PlayerHUDController.
-- El snapshot para la tienda lo reenvía el servidor al invocar GetCatalog.
function ShopController:_ensureDataListener()
	if self._dataConnection or not self._dataUpdated then return end
	self._dataConnection = self._dataUpdated.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data: any)
		if type(data) == "table" then
			self._playerData = data
			self:_refresh()
		end
	end)
end

function ShopController:_isOwned(product: any): boolean
	local inv = self._playerData and self._playerData.Inventory
	local owned = inv and inv.Owned and inv.Owned[product.Category]
	return type(owned) == "table" and owned[product.Id] == true
end

function ShopController:_isEquipped(product: any): boolean
	local inv = self._playerData and self._playerData.Inventory
	return inv ~= nil and inv.Equipped ~= nil and inv.Equipped[product.Category] == product.Id
end

function ShopController:_getProducts(category: string): { any }
	local list = {}
	for _, product in ipairs(self._catalog or {}) do
		if product.Category == category then
			table.insert(list, product)
		end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		if a.Price == b.Price then return tostring(a.Id) < tostring(b.Id) end
		return (a.Price or 0) < (b.Price or 0)
	end)
	return list
end

function ShopController:_getProduct(productId: string?): any
	if not productId then return nil end
	for _, product in ipairs(self._catalog or {}) do
		if product.Id == productId then return product end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Una categoría está activa si el servidor expone productos para ella (proveedor registrado)
function ShopController:_isCategoryActive(category: string): boolean
	return #self:_getProducts(category) > 0
end
